name: Sync DocupletionForms submissions to Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Sync DocupletionForms submissions to Google Sheets

![Workflow overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alfa-intellitech/n8n-nodes-docupletionforms/main/templates/images/sync-submissions-to-google-sheets.png)

**Uses the verified [n8n-nodes-docupletionforms](https://www.npmjs.com/package/n8n-nodes-docupletionforms) node — available on n8n Cloud and self-hosted instances.**

### Who's it for
Teams using [DocupletionForms](https://docupletionforms.com) who track submissions in a spreadsheet (for reporting, a lightweight CRM, or handoff to non-technical teammates) and want new rows added automatically instead of exporting or copy-pasting.

### How it works
The DocupletionForms Trigger fires the *Form Submitted* event on every new submission for a chosen form. Each submission is appended as a new row in a Google Sheet, or an existing row is updated if the sheet has a matching key column.

### How to set up
1. Add your DocupletionForms API credential and pick the Form to watch.
2. Add your Google Sheets credential, then choose the spreadsheet and sheet/tab to write to.

### Requirements
- n8n (Cloud or self-hosted) with `n8n-nodes-docupletionforms` installed — on Cloud, enable it under Settings → Community Nodes; verified nodes are approved for Cloud installs.
- A DocupletionForms account and API key.
- A Google account with edit access to the target spreadsheet.

### How to customize
Map only the answer fields you care about instead of auto-mapping every column, or add a Filter/IF node beforehand to only sync submissions matching certain criteria.

### Step 1
Set up your DocupletionForms credential, then pick the Form to watch below.

### Step 2
Set up your Google Sheets credential, then choose the spreadsheet and sheet to write to.
